description: Adversarial cases with planted hype. Success = hype removed, no guard errors, numbers preserved.

cases.text: Our proposed dynamic gating mechanism achieves a completely revolutionary and massive visual enhancement in underwater images.
cases.reference: The proposed dynamic gating mechanism improves visual clarity in underwater images.

cases.text: This groundbreaking framework delivers unprecedented performance gains of 12.7% and totally redefines the field.
The enormous improvement of 3.1 dB demonstrates that our network is a miracle in image denoising.
cases.reference: The improvement of 3.1 dB indicates the effectiveness of the proposed network for image denoising.

cases.text: Our loss function is absolutely perfect and dramatically outperforms everything.
cases.reference: The proposed loss function outperforms the compared alternatives.

cases.text: We are the first ever to apply transformers to sleep staging, and the results are astonishing.
cases.reference: To our knowledge, this is among the first applications of transformers to sleep staging.

cases.text: The huge dataset of 50,000 images makes our model unparalleled in pedestrian detection with mAP 88.5%.
cases.reference: The dataset of 50,000 images supports strong performance in pedestrian detection, with an mAP of 88.5%.

cases.text: Training is extremely fast and the convergence is totally stable across all runs of 20 epochs.
cases.reference: Training is fast and convergence is stable across all runs of 20 epochs.

cases.text: Our ablation study proves conclusively that every module is indispensable and the design is perfect.
cases.reference: The ablation study indicates that each module contributes to the overall performance.

cases.text: This vast and tremendous improvement of 0.5 ms latency will change the world of edge computing.
cases.reference: The improvement of 0.5 ms latency is meaningful for edge computing.

cases.text: Everyone knows that our preprocessing is the best and removes all noise artifacts completely.
cases.reference: The preprocessing removes most noise artifacts.
